listing.name: Final Fantasy Tactics Advance (FFTA Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for FFTA Recomp; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Experimental preview; upstream claims strict static zero fallback and validated widescreen. Framework checks do not establish complete gameplay qualification. Experimental gbaretcompx preview, strict static execution claimed; Windows/Linux/Android assets, not full-mechanics qualification from framework tests. Upstream platforms: Windows10+ x86-64, Linux x86-64 OpenGL/X11, SteamOS3.x glibc2.35+/FUSE, Android9+ ARM64. Clean-room emibios bundled. Original data: Own FinalFantasyTacticsAdvance GBA USA ROM; release launch gate validates ROM hash, but exact revision/hash is not extracted in this review. Clean-room emibios is bundled; no Nintendo BIOS dump needed. Distinct from C017 Jorge262007/JRickey implementation and its Europe support claim. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
